company.name: Magnitude
company.shortDescription: Magnitude is an autonomous AI workforce platform that offers third-party cyber risk management services.
company.description: Magnitude deploys an autonomous AI workforce of risk agents engineered to modernize third-party risk management for enterprises. The platform continuously assesses vendor vulnerabilities and governs external AI interactions across both direct partners and downstream Nth-party supply chain dependencies. By gathering evidence and automating remediations according to specific enterprise rules, the system replaces static periodic compliance checks with a real-time defense mechanism against machine-scale supply chain attacks

productsAndServices.description: An autonomous AI workforce platform whose risk agents continuously assess and remediate third- and Nth-party risk for TPRM teams.
